name: broodscale bloodchief

winrate_basis.source: statistics_matchups(format=modern, archetype_a='pinnacle affinity', limit=60), committed verbatim at .protocol/raw-matchups.json; row 'broodscale bloodchief' at 0.4234 over 58 matches / 137 games

primary_gameplan: Be the faster deck. Weapons Manufacturing on turn two, then every {0} artifact is a Munitions token and Claws of Gix converts each one into two damage for {1}. The drain does not care about a growing creature and does not ask us to block.
secondary_gameplan: Where the drain is not assembled, Consign to Memory holds the game together: it counters Sowing Mycospawn and Thief of Existence as colorless spells, and it counters the Basking Broodscale spawn trigger, which is where their mana comes from.
opponent_gameplan: Ten captured 2026-09-10 lists run Basking Broodscale with Blade of the Bloodchief: adapt puts a +1/+1 counter on the Broodscale, that makes an Eldrazi Spawn token, the token is sacrificed for mana, and Blade of the Bloodchief grows the creature every time something dies. Ancient Stirrings and Malevolent Rumble find the pieces, Sowing Mycospawn fetches Eldrazi Temple and can exile one of our lands when kicked, and Emrakul, the Promised End is the top end their Ugin's Labyrinth banks.
pitfalls: Leading on Blood Moon. Ten of ten captured boards hold two Nature's Claim, and the Moon costs us four Urza's Saga and eleven coloured sources while it is on the battlefield.

Holding Engineered Explosives for a big number. Basking Broodscale is mana value 2 and Blade of the Bloodchief is mana value 1, so the numbers that matter are 1 and 2, and both are reachable off one blue and one red source.
Treating Eldrazi Spawn tokens as blockers to attack past. They are sacrificed for mana at instant speed, so Kappa Cannoneer's unblockable clause is what actually closes and Skateboard's haste is not.

phase_plan.late: Damping Sphere caps Eldrazi Temple and Ugin's Labyrinth at one mana; Kappa Cannoneer closes through spawn tokens because it cannot be blocked.

11 of the captured board slots are Trinisphere. Every spell costs three, and sixteen of our maindeck cards cost {0}, so it is the single worst card in the field against this shell.

8 of the 10 captured boards run it. It names Kappa Cannoneer or Weapons Manufacturing for {3} more, and its second clause switches off the named card's activated abilities unless they are mana abilities.
8 of the 10 captured boards run it, and it counters every one of our sixteen {0} spells outright because no mana is spent to cast them.

stance_rationale: At 6.95pp this is the second largest row in the recorded field and the capture records us at 0.4234 over 58 matches, so it is a recorded worst case. Their lists are Eldrazi Temple, Ugin's Labyrinth, Cavern of Souls, Urza's Saga and Yavimaya over two or three basic Forests, and the whole board is aimed at making that mana and their spawn-token engine cost more than it produces.

play_plan.goldfish_for: Weapons Manufacturing on turn two into Claws of Gix, so the Munitions tokens answer the Broodscale rather than the face.
play_plan.watch_for: A turn-one Ancient Stirrings means Trinisphere or Disruptor Flute is already found; deploy the {0} artifacts before they untap with three mana.
play_plan.posture_why: The capture records 0.4234 over 58 matches; long games belong to their engine.

opponent_plan.posture_why: Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief assemble a growing creature and free mana from turn two, so they close before a slower artifact draw is online.
